classification.difficultyReason: Identify parallel sides and perpendicular separation in rotated diagrams, ignore sloping side lengths, and convert centimetres to metres before applying the area formula.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these trapeziums.

spec.description: Unfilled trapezium with a longer horizontal upper base extending left of the shorter lower base, a vertical right side, matching rightward parallel arrows and a lower-right right-angle marker.
spec.answerVisibility: All four measurements and geometric marks are permanent student givens. The area appears only in answer fields.

answer.worked:
The parallel sides are $6\text{ cm}$ and $3\text{ cm}$, and the perpendicular height is $4\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A &= \frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A &= \frac{4(6+3)}{2}\\A &= 18\text{ cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rotated unfilled trapezium with parallel sides descending to the right, matching arrows, a right-angle marker at the upper vertex and the longer parallel side ending at the lowest vertex.

mathematics.construction: The parallel-side difference is 4 km; the remaining side is the hypotenuse of a 3–4–5 triangle.

spec.answerVisibility: All four measurements and geometric marks are permanent student givens. The area appears only in answer fields.

answer.worked:
The parallel sides are $2.8\text{ km}$ and $6.8\text{ km}$. The right-angle marker identifies $3\text{ km}$ as the perpendicular height.
$$\begin{align*}A &= \frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A &= \frac{3(2.8+6.8)}{2}\\A &= 14.4\text{ km}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Vertical parallel sides with the longer side on the left, a horizontal top edge, a lower edge rising to the right, two upper right-angle markers and external double-ended dimension arrows. The erroneous source sloping-side label is corrected to 5 cm.

mathematics.construction: The vertical difference is 7−3=4 cm and the horizontal separation is 3 cm, so the sloping side is 5 cm.

spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions and right-angle markers are permanent student givens. The area appears only in answer fields.

answer.worked:
The vertical parallel sides are $7\text{ cm}$ and $3\text{ cm}$. Their perpendicular separation is $3\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A &= \frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A &= \frac{3(7+3)}{2}\\A &= 15\text{ cm}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rotated unfilled trapezium whose long parallel sides rise to the right. External double-ended arrows give the left side as 2 m and the right side as 250 cm. An internal transverse double-ended arrow near the upper end gives the perpendicular separation as 1 m. No parallel marks or right-angle marker are added.

mathematics.construction: The parallel sides are 2 m and 2.5 m; the internal dimension joins corresponding perpendicular points.

spec.answerVisibility: The mixed-unit dimensions and transverse height are permanent student givens. The conversion and area appear only in answer fields.

answer.worked:
$250\text{ cm}=2.5\text{ m}$. The parallel sides are $2\text{ m}$ and $2.5\text{ m}$, and the perpendicular height is $1\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}A &= \frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A &= \frac{1(2+2.5)}{2}\\A &= 2.25\text{ m}^{2}\end{align*}$$
